verdict.rationale: Chroma's docs confirm that metadata filtering exists and can be combined with `where_document` filters using $contains/$not_contains and $regex/$not_regex operators, so the product does have its own query-filtering capability. The pack does not show the rich condition types the story names. missing for 10: range operators, geo filters, nested boolean (AND/OR) logic, array-membership operators, detailed metadata-filter operator docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can express rich filter conditions (ranges, geo, nested boolean logic, array membership) in queries

citations.quote: `.get` and `.query` can handle `where_document` search combined with metadata filtering
We support full-text search with the `$contains` and `$not_contains` operators. We also support regular expression pattern matching with the `$regex` and `$not_regex` operators.
